text:
Jordan K: Thanks for joining todays all-hands. Quick follow-up thread for the Q&A items we didnt finish live. Owners: please ack and drop a short ETA (hours/days).

Meera S: Ack. I'll take the public FAQ blurb (short Q&A we can share on the docs landing). Will post copy as PR DOCS-501 by Tue.

Tom H: I'll own canary/pass criteria for Dedicated rollouts and the quantization profiles we support. Filing ROLL-202 now. Question: do canaries run with the same batching config as prod?

Jordan K: Good call. Canary should use the production batching profile where feasible; note any deliberate deviations in the runbook.

Product Team Bot: Request logged: PROD-994 (canonical prompt sets + minimal repro data for perf regressions). Product please attach prompts to redwood/evals by end of week.

Tom H: Got it. Will design canary checks to include perf, correctness (evals), and kv cache behavior. ETA: first draft ROLL-202 by Thu.

Meera S: Quick Q: for the FAQ blurb, do we publicly state numeric latency targets or keep them as "targets"?

Jordan K: Keep public blurb high-level (target latency buckets), put exact P95 numbers in SLA appendix only. Meera include a one-line pointer to the SLA page.

Legal Bot: Note: For Private/on-prem EU customers, some industries may need addenda. Recommend case-by-case legal review. Tag LEGAL-77 for intake.

Jordan K: Thanks Legal Bot. Maria from Sales asked about a short one-paragraph customer-facing explanation of Dedicated vs Private for sales playbooks. Can Marketing/Sales draft that?

Meera S: I can draft a 2-sentence playbook blurb and attach to DOCS-501 PR.

Tom H: One more technical ask: Product/ML, please list the top 3 models we should pin during early canaries and supply a small validation dataset. This helps keep canary runs consistent.

Product Team Bot: Confirmed. Will attach model list + validation slices to PROD-994 by Fri.

eng-bot: Recording + slides uploaded: https://drive.redwood.com/all-hands/jul-2026  Recording: https://redwood.zoom.us/rec/share/qrs7890 (internal access)

Jordan K: Office hours offer: Ill hold 30m on Wed 11am PT to triage any blockers for these items (drop a note here if you want a slot).

Tom H: Ack. Will present ROLL-202 draft on Wed office hours.

Meera S: Ack. Will post DOCS-501 PR prior to Wed 11am.

Jordan K: Action recap: Meera  DOCS-501 public FAQ + sales blurb (PR by Tue/Wed); Tom  ROLL-202 canary + quant profiles (draft Thu, present Wed office hours); Product  PROD-994 prompts + model pins (by Fri); Legal  LEGAL-77 intake for EU on-prem addenda. Add short ETAs in your tickets and reply here with :white_check_mark: when done.

Tom H: :white_check_mark: (ROLL-202 filed, draft in progress)

Meera S: :white_check_mark: (will open PR today)

Jordan K: Thanks everyone  closing follow-up in 72h if no further asks. If anything urgent, DM me or ping #product.
